stories.headline: ChatGPT *Rivals* Google Search Volume
stories.facts: OpenAI announced that the volume of search queries processed through ChatGPT has reached 20 percent of Google's total search volume.
stories.caption_line: 🔍 ChatGPT search volume hits 20% of Google's massive scale.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic collage featuring a sleek smartphone displaying glowing search data in the foreground, with massive digital server towers in the midground and holographic rising search metrics floating above. Electric-blue and warm-orange lighting creates a dramatic studio atmosphere.
stories.source_title: OpenAI says ChatGPT is catching up to Google in search

stories.headline: Google *Blocks* Student Search
stories.facts: Google confirmed that K-12 student accounts rejecting its AI tools will lose access to Google Search entirely.
stories.caption_line: 🏫 Google cuts off search for schools rejecting AI tools.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic composition showing a modern empty classroom in the foreground with a glowing digital tablet on a desk, a large school building exterior in the midground, and holographic warning overlays and network lines. Electric-blue and warm-orange neon lighting.
stories.source_title: Google is entirely disabling Search in schools that don’t want AI

stories.headline: Siri *Supercharges* Third-Party Apps
stories.facts: Apple's iOS 27.3 update allows Siri AI to take actions and draw on personal context across all third-party apps.
stories.caption_line: 📱 Siri expands AI actions to all third-party mobile apps.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic carousel slide showing a modern smartphone displaying vibrant app icons in the foreground, a sleek city skyline in the midground, and floating holographic user interface panels and data streams. Dramatic sunset lighting with electric-blue and warm-orange tones.
stories.source_title: Apple starts giving Siri AI access to third-party apps

stories.headline: AI Agents *Scan* Deep Space
stories.facts: The SETI Institute and Breakthrough Listen deployed AI agents at the Allen Telescope Array to control operations and analyze radio signals, detecting a pulsar in the Crab Nebula.
stories.caption_line: 🔭 Autonomous AI agents take over deep space telescope arrays.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic composition featuring a massive radio telescope dish in the foreground, a starry night sky and observatory in the midground, and glowing holographic star maps and data streams. Electric-blue and warm-orange rim lighting.
stories.source_title: AI agents take over at SETI's Allen Telescope Array, scanning for extraterrestrial intelligence

stories.headline: Huawei *Outsources* Chip Memory
stories.facts: Huawei is telling customers to source high-performance memory for AI chips independently, pushing buyers toward black market channels.
stories.caption_line: ⚠️ Huawei directs buyers to black market for chip memory.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic tech collage with a high-end computer microchip in the foreground, a complex factory assembly line in the midground, and floating holographic circuit diagrams and network lines. Electric-blue and warm-orange studio lighting.
stories.source_title: Huawei tells customers to find their own AI chip memory, effectively outsourcing procurement to the black market

stories.headline: OpenAI *Hires* Former Army Head
stories.facts: OpenAI hired Dan Driscoll, the former civilian head of the US Army, as Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization.
stories.caption_line: 🛡️ OpenAI brings on former Army Secretary for national security.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic portrait-style composition featuring a confident professional man in a sharp suit in the foreground, a grand government building in the midground, and holographic security network overlays. Dramatic studio lighting with electric-blue and warm-orange tones.
stories.source_title: OpenAI hires ex-Army Secretary, gaining bipartisan reach just as midterms loom

stories.headline: Anthropic *Slashes* Token Delays
stories.facts: Anthropic introduced Message Threads for the Messages API, cutting the time to the first token by 35 percent for conversations between 500,000 and one million tokens.
stories.caption_line: ⚡ Anthropic reduces latency for long-running AI conversations.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic carousel slide featuring glowing server racks in the foreground, a modern software development workspace in the midground, and floating holographic latency charts and data streams. Electric-blue and warm-orange color palette.
stories.source_title: Anthropic's Message Threads cut time to first token by 35 percent for long conversations
